description: We’re SideLoaders, a beginner-friendly team excited to build something fun for NASA Space Apps. Looking for coders, game/UI designers, someone into data or AI, and a video/pitch person. All skill levels welcome. First hackathon? Ours too, so come learn and build with us
summary: Red Soil: Outpost 7 is a pixel-art Mars base game that trains children aged 7 to 12 as junior astronauts. Players keep a small outpost alive by managing power, water, air, food and radiation across six short missions: an airlock safety check, cleaning dusty solar panels, rewiring the power unit, digging and melting buried ice, sharing water between oxygen and plants, sheltering from a solar flare, and repairing a radio dish to call Earth. Each mission teaches one real idea from NASA science, built on NASA DONKI space-weather alerts, Curiosity's radiation measurements, NASA OSDR plant research and facts from NASA's Mars missions. LUNA, a friendly helper drone, reads the instructions aloud and answers questions in simple words. The game runs in any web browser on computers, tablets and phones, works offline, and needs no install or account,
details:
The player is a cadet sent to Outpost 7, a Mars base hit by a dust storm. After the rocket trip from Earth, LUNA the drone guides them through six training missions. Each one is a small job a real crew would face

After graduating, the player gets a printable Junior Astronaut certificate, and Mission Control keeps sending bonus jobs. Between missions the base keeps running: crops grow, batteries drain at night, dust storms are forecast and the solar panels must be folded away before they hit, meteorites land, and solar flares send everyone to the shelter.
The whole game is written in TypeScript on the HTML5 Canvas and built with Vite into one HTML filethat contains the code, art, sound and mission data.
TypeScript, HTML5 Canvas, CSS, Vite, Vitest (automated tests), Prettier, GitHub Actions and GitHub Pages; the browser Web Speech API for LUNA's voice; Google Gemini (free tier) behind a Cloudflare Worker for LUNA's chat; Claude by Anthropic as a coding assistant.
